text: The system shall be fast and user-friendly.
The system must respond within 200 milliseconds.
Data retention period should be appropriate.
System must comply with relevant privacy regulations.
The system shall lock user accounts after 5 failed login attempts within 15 minutes.
The system must notify users via email after account lockout.
Passwords must be hashed using Argon2.
The system should maybe implement captcha.
Security features must be adequate.

The system shall process international wire transfers. The system must validate recipient bank details against SWIFT database. If validation fails, the system shall notify the user and log the attempt.
The system must handle many concurrent users. Page load should be quick. Database queries must be optimized.
The system shall allow users to register with email and password.
The system should be reliable and secure.
The system shall generate daily sales reports in PDF format.
Users can add items to shopping cart. The system usually processes payments quickly.
The braking system shall engage within 50 milliseconds when the obstacle is detected at 10 meters.
The system must sound an alarm immediately. Brake pressure must reach 100% within 100 milliseconds.
The REST API must support GET and POST methods. Endpoints shall return JSON responses.
The system should handle many concurrent requests.
Error messages must be descriptive enough.
The system shall provide adequate security for user data.
The system must encrypt all passwords using bcrypt with a cost factor of 12.
The application should be user-friendly and easy to navigate.
The login page must display a 'Forgot Password' link that directs to the password reset flow.
The system shall handle a large number of concurrent users efficiently.
The system shall support up to 10,000 concurrent users with a response time under 200ms.
The software must be reliable and robust against failures.
The system must recover from database failures within 30 seconds using automatic failover.
The API should return appropriate error messages.
The API must return HTTP status 400 with a JSON error object containing 'code' and 'message' fields for validation failures.
The system shall process transactions quickly.
The system shall process international wire transfers within 5 seconds of submission.
The user interface should be visually appealing and modern.
The dashboard must display real-time metrics updated every 10 seconds using WebSocket connections.
The system shall maintain audit logs for all critical actions.
The system must record audit logs including timestamp, user ID, action type, and IP address for all write operations.
The search feature should be fast and accurate.
The search must return results within 300ms for queries up to 50 characters and sort by relevance score.
The system should handle errors gracefully.
The system must display a user-friendly error page with a support contact link for all unhandled exceptions.
The mobile app shall be responsive on all devices.
The mobile app must adapt to screen widths between 320px and 768px with touch-friendly button sizes of at least 44x44px.
The system must allow users to reset their passwords, but also prevent password resets for security reasons.
The system must allow users to reset their passwords via email link and enforce a 15-minute expiry window.
The reporting module should generate comprehensive reports for management.
The reporting module must generate daily sales reports in PDF format including total revenue, top products, and regional breakdowns.
The system should be able to handle peak loads without degradation.
The system must maintain 99.9% availability and handle up to 5,000 requests per minute without degradation.
The application must include proper input validation to prevent injection attacks.
The application must validate all user inputs against a whitelist of allowed characters and reject any payload exceeding 1MB.
The system shall send email notifications to users when required.
The system shall send email notifications to users within 5 seconds of account creation, including a verification link.
The software shall be cost-effective to maintain.
The software must have a modular architecture allowing replacement of any component without affecting others, with documented APIs.
The system should allow users to cancel their orders, but once canceled, orders cannot be restored.
The system must allow users to cancel orders within 5 minutes of placement, and permanently delete canceled orders after 30 days.
The authentication mechanism must be secure.
The authentication mechanism must support OAuth2 with refresh tokens and enforce 2FA for users with admin roles.
The system shall provide reasonable performance under load.
The system must maintain an average response time of ≤150ms under 70% load for all read-only endpoints.
The platform should be accessible to users with disabilities.
The platform must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards including keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
The system must handle file uploads, but also restrict file types.
The system must accept PDF, PNG, and JPEG uploads up to 5MB, and reject all other formats with a clear error message.
The chatbot should understand user queries effectively.
The chatbot must achieve 95% intent classification accuracy on a test dataset of 10,000 user messages.
The system shall store user preferences, but should also respect GDPR regulations.
The system shall store user preferences and provide a data export API that returns all stored data in JSON format within 30 seconds.
The payment gateway integration should be reliable.
The payment gateway integration must retry failed transactions up to 3 times with exponential backoff and log each attempt.
The system must enforce strong password policies, but not make it too hard for users.
The system must enforce passwords with minimum 12 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character.
The application should be able to scale horizontally.
The application must support horizontal scaling with stateless sessions stored in Redis and zero-downtime deployments.
The system shall generate invoices for customers when needed.
The system must generate invoices within 2 seconds of order confirmation and email them as PDF attachments.
The reporting dashboard should visualize KPIs clearly.
The reporting dashboard must display 12 KPIs including revenue, conversion rate, and churn with interactive charts (bar/line/pie).
The system must allow administrators to delete user accounts, but also maintain data retention policies.
The system must allow administrators to delete user accounts on request and purge all associated data within 7 days.
The search functionality should be efficient for large datasets.
The search must return results within 1 second for datasets up to 1 million records using Elasticsearch with pagination.
The system should be easy to deploy and maintain.
The system must be deployable via Docker Compose with documented environment variables and health check endpoints.
The API should be designed to be future-proof and extensible.
The API must use semantic versioning and include an OpenAPI 3.0 specification with all endpoints documented.
The system must implement caching for performance, but must also invalidate cache on updates.
The system must implement Redis caching with TTL of 5 minutes and invalidate cache on any write operation.
The mobile app should provide a smooth user experience.
The mobile app must render at 60 FPS on devices running Android 10+ and maintain smooth scrolling with virtualized lists.
The system shall support multiple languages for the interface.
The system must support English, Malay, and Chinese with dynamic language switching without page reload.
The software must be secure against common web vulnerabilities.
The software must pass OWASP Top 10 security scans with zero critical vulnerabilities and enforce CSP headers.
The system should integrate with third-party services reliably.
The system must integrate with Stripe, Twilio, and SendGrid with retry policies and circuit breakers for each.
The application must be user-friendly for both technical and non-technical users.
The application must provide role-specific dashboards for 5 user roles with guided tours for first-time users.
The system should be fast enough for all users.
The system must handle 500 concurrent users with average response time below 300ms.
The system shall handle all user inputs.
The system must support file uploads without errors.
The system shall respond in a reasonable time.
The software must be secure for all users.
